mapper.select: SELECT payload_sha256 FROM catalog_event_inbox WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_catalog_projection(store_id,status,store_event_version,deleted_at) VALUES(#{storeId},#{data.status},#{eventVersion},#{data.deletedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = IF(VALUES(store_event_version) > store_event_version, VALUES(status), status), deleted_at = IF(VALUES(store_event_version) > store_event_version, VALUES(deleted_at), deleted_at), store_event_version = GREATEST(store_event_version, VALUES(store_event_version))

INSERT INTO menu_catalog_projection(menu_id,store_id,status,menu_event_version) VALUES(#{data.menuId},#{storeId},#{data.status},#{eventVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = IF(store_id = VALUES(store_id) AND VALUES(menu_event_version) > menu_event_version, VALUES(status), status), menu_event_version = IF(store_id = VALUES(store_id), GREATEST(menu_event_version,VALUES(menu_event_version)),menu_event_version)
